utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m interested in helping, Rey, but I’d really need the exact drop-off window and location before I can commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have the exact window yet, Pia, but Cleo’s putting the supply list together, so I’ll check with her and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. Once you’ve got the time, location, and what supplies are actually needed, I can see what I can realistically do.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Quinn! I’m still waiting on Faye’s clearer list for the repair drive, but I’m asking around so I can pass along who’s bringing tools and what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — once Faye sends the clearer list, I can help spread it around fast. Just let me know what’s still needed and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Quinn — I’ll send it your way as soon as Faye gets me the details, especially anything folks still need to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Jules, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details, but I told Rosa I could help at the sign-up table if they still need me there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Nell—Saturday late morning from 10 to 1 is what I’m sharing around, so I’ll mention you’re available for the sign-up table and check whether Rosa still needs you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — that works for me. Please let me know if Rosa wants me somewhere else, and I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I heard there’s a repair drive coming together, but Noah said folks are still sorting out the details—once he hears more, I’ll pass it around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’m a bit behind as usual, but Cleo’s starting a list and I’m asking around about supplies. If Noah hears specifics, send them my way and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Dane—I’ll send along anything Noah tells me, and I’ll let folks know Cleo’s list is where updates should land.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, before I take on anything for the repair drive, do you know which repairs are confirmed in writing and who’s been named to keep the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Honestly, Hana, I only caught the basics—community room Saturday and they need easy volunteer help. Rosa’s the one coordinating, so I’d ask her about what’s confirmed and who has the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo—that helps. I’ll check with Rosa before I commit or ask anyone to contribute.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I’m filling the repair drive roster now—Nell can take sign-up with a quick rundown, and Bo can cover coffee or check-in for two hours, so what I most need from you is help sorting tools and labeling donated parts if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe — but can you confirm the exact time and drop-off spot first? If you’ve got the list, I can help sort the tools and label the parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, thank you — we’re sorting from 10 to noon at the community room, and tool drop-off is the side entrance by the bulletin board. I’ll have the list and labels ready for you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: Saturday at 9, with your list ready. We’ll start at my place and work down the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be at your place Saturday at 9 with my list ready, and I’ll make sure I’m back in time for the 10–12 intake table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam. Bring your list, and we’ll keep the morning tidy and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning, about 10 to 1, and I’m still confirming what families can bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s good—can you send me the written repair list and tell me who’s keeping the ledger? I want those names settled before anyone brings money.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send the written repair list and confirm who’s keeping the ledger as soon as I’ve settled the names.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—Saturday at 9, I think. Thanks for the reminder; I’ll keep my list ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren — I’ve heard both around 10 and now 9 for Saturday, so I’ll mark the time as unconfirmed until I check the flyer or hear from Marta.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s wise, Opal—I’m not the best source when times start wobbling. Please check the flyer or Marta, and I’ll hold off saying it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, mostly we still need tables, a few tool donations, and a couple more setup volunteers. If you hear of any gaps, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—tables, tools, and setup volunteers, got it. I’ll pass that to Vik and ask around, and if I hear any other gaps I’ll circle back to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks Noah—I’m out running errands now, so if anything comes up today just send it my way and I’ll mention it to folks I bump into.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mara, I’m pulling together the repair drive supply list—so far I’ve got tape, gloves, spare parts, and maybe tools or extra wood, but I’m checking what folks already have before we buy anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — I’m also checking with the organizers today for the first repair list and volunteer names, so I’ll make sure we don’t buy supplies until we know what folks can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Mara—send me whatever the organizers confirm, and I’ll keep the supply list marked tentative until we know what people can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, if you need any tools for the repair drive, I can lend a few—just tell me what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — we still need a couple basic tool donations, so screwdrivers, pliers, or a socket set would help. Label anything you want back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo—I’ll bring screwdrivers, pliers, and my socket set with labels on them. I’ll just need the socket set back that evening.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I’m waiting on Noah to confirm the repair drive details, but once he hears back I’ll help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that’s perfect. Once Noah confirms, I’ll send you the final time, location, and volunteer needs so you can share a clean note with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — once you send the final time, location, and volunteer needs, I’ll pass it along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, let’s keep it simple: Saturday at 9, bring your repair list, and we’ll start at my place before moving down the block.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — could you also confirm exactly where we should drop things off first so I don’t send anyone to the wrong place?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: For now, have folks drop things at my place first on Saturday at 9, and I’ll check with Marta so we don’t cross wires.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nell, I can’t be much use at the drive itself, but I’ve got a few tools set aside if they’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, Uli—thank you. What kind of tools did you set aside?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hand tools—pliers, a wrench set, a couple screwdrivers. I can leave them by the back door tomorrow morning if someone’s able to collect them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Kira, yes—the repair drive is meant to start Saturday at 9, beginning at Eli’s place, though I still need to double-check the sign-up sheet before I promise who’s covering what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you confirm Saturday at 9 at Eli’s before I pass it on? And once you’ve checked the sign-up sheet, send me who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes—Saturday at 9 at Eli’s is the plan, and I’ll check the sign-up sheet so I can send you who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the leaky gutters by the community room and a few broken porch steps, from what I’ve heard. I’m still checking whether anything else needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey. Please confirm what else you find, and I’ll line up setup help around the gutters and steps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Saturday late morning still works best for the repair drive, and I’ll make sure both groups get the details today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Jules — Saturday late morning works for me too. I’ll keep an eye out for any last-minute gaps on tables, tool donations, or setup volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Ira — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I’m happy to pitch in for the repair drive—just tell me what tools you’re short on, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—I’m checking the repair list with the organizers today so I don’t guess, but if you can hold off a bit, I’ll tell you exactly what tools we’re short on as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds perfect, Mara—just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll set aside whatever I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, I’m still firming up the repair drive supply list—so far I’ve got tape, gloves, spare parts, and maybe tools or extra wood. Do you know what folks can already bring before we buy anything?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus can lend a socket set, cordless drill, screwdrivers, pliers, and clamps, but he needs the drill and socket set back that evening. Before we buy anything, who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, I’ll mark Gus’s tools as borrowed with the drill and socket set due back that evening. I’m keeping the supply list, but I still need to confirm who’s writing the repair list and who’ll keep the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess — I’ve got the repair drive tentatively at the community room by the laundromat around 10 Saturday, but I’m still checking the flyer or Marta to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Opal — I’ll tell folks it’s looking like 10 Saturday by the laundromat, but I’ll say it’s tentative until you hear back from Marta or see the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Tess—please keep it marked tentative, and I’ll let you know as soon as Marta or the flyer confirms the exact spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Quinn—I'm still a little fuzzy on the repair drive details, but I promised Vik I'd check around, so I'll ask and pass along whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah—if you get the confirmed time, location, and drop-off setup, could you let me know too? I’ve got Pia and Nell waiting on the solid details before I spread it further.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Absolutely — I’ll check around for the confirmed time, location, and drop-off setup, then pass it your way too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — could you help spread the word and let me know what tools or supplies you can bring? Saturday late morning still works best for me around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Faye — I’ll help spread the word, and I’m already covering the Saturday 10–12 intake table with a roll of masking tape, so I can bring that along too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m a bit late catching up, but Cleo’s starting the supply list with tape, gloves, and spare parts, and I’m asking around for what else folks need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—before we add more, can you check whether those supplies match the confirmed repair list and who’s keeping the ledger for any spending?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good point, Hana—I’ll check the confirmed repair list before we add anything else. I don’t know who’s keeping the ledger yet, but I’ll ask Cleo and make sure spending doesn’t get scattered.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
